ELS is hiring for the position of Experienced Marina Fork Truck Driver in Dunedin, Florida. What you'll do: The Fork Truck Driver operates and manages large capacity Marine Forklifts.

As an Equal Opportunity Employer, we welcome and thank all applicants.
